clock: On Windows, Node process.hrtime.bigint and System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch use QueryPerformanceCounter. Raw values are converted to nanoseconds and must align with marker-receipt causality; any origin/order mismatch is DIAGNOSTIC_INCOMPLETE.

buckets.meaning: process launch, script entry, native/runtime initialization, framed request read, canonical/schema validation, and complete path/root/operation validation
pending-file checked chain acquisition, held-handle stability, fresh reopen, and identity materialization
canonical serialization, frame construction, first response write, complete response write, and flush
buffered diagnostic telemetry, exit initiation, process close, and all three pipe closures

dominance: A bucket's classification is selected only when that bucket is the unique measured duration greater than 50 percent of T0-T13. Otherwise classify OTHER_CONCRETE_DOMINANT_COST with basis no_unique_majority and preserve every named bucket, so fallback is distinguishable from a dominant responseObjectCompletion bucket.
incomplete: DIAGNOSTIC_INCOMPLETE when T0-T13, every T1-T12 helper tick, every external marker receipt, all required counter snapshots, QPC alignment, canonical response, exact fixture, or monotonic/order checks are unavailable or invalid.
